description: Synthetic 0.1.0 operators, native credentials, two published revisions, stable graph, completed and quarantined responses, pending response outbox, invitations and delivery history.

checks.query: SELECT 'audit_entries' AS table_name, json_object('id',id,'workspace_id',workspace_id,'kind',kind,'actor_operator_id',actor_operator_id,'subject_type',subject_type,'subject_id',subject_id,'details_json',details_json,'created_at',created_at) AS row_json FROM audit_entries UNION ALL SELECT 'choice_options' AS table_name, json_object('id',id,'step_id',step_id,'value',value,'label',label,'position',position,'created_at',created_at,'updated_at',updated_at,'stable_id',stable_id) AS row_json FROM choice_options UNION ALL SELECT 'distribution_contacts' AS table_name, json_object('id',id,'workspace_id',workspace_id,'email',email,'name',name,'opted_out_at',opted_out_at,'created_at',created_at,'updated_at',updated_at) AS row_json FROM distribution_contacts UNION ALL SELECT 'flow_branch_rules' AS table_name, json_object('id',id,'revision_id',revision_id,'source_step_stable_id',source_step_stable_id,'predicate_kind',predicate_kind,'expected_value_json',expected_value_json,'destination_step_stable_id',destination_step_stable_id,'position',position,'created_at',created_at,'updated_at',updated_at) AS row_json FROM flow_branch_rules UNION ALL SELECT 'flow_revisions' AS table_name, json_object('id',id,'flow_id',flow_id,'number',number,'state',state,'title',title,'published_at',published_at,'created_at',created_at,'updated_at',updated_at,'is_current',is_current,'admission_closed_at',admission_closed_at,'admission_close_reason',admission_close_reason,'deadline_at',deadline_at,'deadline_time_zone',deadline_time_zone,'target_completed_responses',target_completed_responses,'policy_snapshot_json',policy_snapshot_json) AS row_json FROM flow_revisions UNION ALL SELECT 'flow_steps' AS table_name, json_object('id',id,'revision_id',revision_id,'position',position,'kind',kind,'question_type',question_type,'prompt',prompt,'helper_text',helper_text,'required',required,'created_at',created_at,'updated_at',updated_at,'stable_id',stable_id,'next_step_stable_id',next_step_stable_id,'question_settings_json',question_settings_json) AS row_json FROM flow_steps UNION ALL SELECT 'flows' AS table_name, json_object('id',id,'workspace_id',workspace_id,'slug',slug,'title',title,'status',status,'draft_version',draft_version,'last_activity_at',last_activity_at,'created_at',created_at,'updated_at',updated_at) AS row_json FROM flows UNION ALL SELECT 'invitation_launches' AS table_name, json_object('id',id,'workspace_id',workspace_id,'revision_id',revision_id,'command_key',command_key,'policy_json',policy_json,'actor_operator_id',actor_operator_id,'created_at',created_at) AS row_json FROM invitation_launches UNION ALL SELECT 'invitation_participants' AS table_name, json_object('id',id,'launch_id',launch_id,'workspace_id',workspace_id,'revision_id',revision_id,'contact_id',contact_id,'email_snapshot',email_snapshot,'name_snapshot',name_snapshot,'token',token,'opt_out_token',opt_out_token,'delivery_status',delivery_status,'response_status',response_status,'completed_at',completed_at,'completion_step_id',completion_step_id,'created_at',created_at) AS row_json FROM invitation_participants UNION ALL SELECT 'mail_deliveries' AS table_name, json_object('id',id,'participant_id',participant_id,'kind',kind,'status',status,'idempotency_key',idempotency_key,'available_at',available_at,'first_attempt_at',first_attempt_at,'last_attempt_at',last_attempt_at,'attempts',attempts,'provider_id',provider_id,'reason',reason,'created_at',created_at,'updated_at',updated_at) AS row_json FROM mail_deliveries UNION ALL SELECT 'mail_delivery_attempts' AS table_name, json_object('id',id,'delivery_id',delivery_id,'ordinal',ordinal,'event',event,'actor_operator_id',actor_operator_id,'reason',reason,'provider_id',provider_id,'created_at',created_at) AS row_json FROM mail_delivery_attempts UNION ALL SELECT 'oa_bootstrap' AS table_name, json_object('singleton',singleton,'claim_id',claim_id,'claimed_at',claimed_at) AS row_json FROM oa_bootstrap UNION ALL SELECT 'oa_operators' AS table_name, json_object('id',id,'email',email,'display_name',display_name,'role',role,'status',status,'version',version,'created_at',created_at) AS row_json FROM oa_operators UNION ALL SELECT 'oa_sessions' AS table_name, json_object('id',id,'token_hash',token_hash,'operator_id',operator_id,'operator_version',operator_version,'kind',kind,'source_token_id',source_token_id,'created_at',created_at,'expires_at',expires_at,'revoked_at',revoked_at) AS row_json FROM oa_sessions UNION ALL SELECT 'oa_tokens' AS table_name, json_object('id',id,'token_hash',token_hash,'kind',kind,'operator_id',operator_id,'operator_version',operator_version,'issuer_id',issuer_id,'issuer_version',issuer_version,'return_to',return_to,'created_at',created_at,'expires_at',expires_at,'consumed_at',consumed_at,'revoked_at',revoked_at) AS row_json FROM oa_tokens UNION ALL SELECT 'operator_auth_links' AS table_name, json_object('operator_id',operator_id,'auth_id',auth_id) AS row_json FROM operator_auth_links UNION ALL SELECT 'operators' AS table_name, json_object('id',id,'workspace_id',workspace_id,'email',email,'display_name',display_name,'created_at',created_at,'updated_at',updated_at,'is_setup_operator',is_setup_operator) AS row_json FROM operators UNION ALL SELECT 'respondent_session_step_events' AS table_name, json_object('id',id,'session_id',session_id,'revision_id',revision_id,'step_stable_id',step_stable_id,'counted_at',counted_at,'created_at',created_at) AS row_json FROM respondent_session_step_events UNION ALL SELECT 'respondent_sessions' AS table_name, json_object('id',id,'revision_id',revision_id,'source',source,'device_class',device_class,'furthest_step_id',furthest_step_id,'completed_at',completed_at,'expires_at',expires_at,'created_at',created_at,'updated_at',updated_at,'session_token_hash',session_token_hash,'metric_folded_at',metric_folded_at,'completion_outcome',completion_outcome) AS row_json FROM respondent_sessions UNION ALL SELECT 'response_answers' AS table_name, json_object('id',id,'response_id',response_id,'step_id',step_id,'value_json',value_json,'created_at',created_at,'updated_at',updated_at) AS row_json FROM response_answers UNION ALL SELECT 'response_outbox' AS table_name, json_object('id',id,'workspace_id',workspace_id,'response_id',response_id,'kind',kind,'idempotency_key',idempotency_key,'payload_json',payload_json,'status',status,'available_at',available_at,'dispatched_at',dispatched_at,'failure_reason',failure_reason,'created_at',created_at,'updated_at',updated_at) AS row_json FROM response_outbox UNION ALL SELECT 'responses' AS table_name, json_object('id',id,'workspace_id',workspace_id,'flow_id',flow_id,'revision_id',revision_id,'session_id',session_id,'session_token_hash',session_token_hash,'idempotency_key',idempotency_key,'state',state,'quarantine_reason',quarantine_reason,'released_at',released_at,'released_by_operator_id',released_by_operator_id,'completion_milliseconds',completion_milliseconds,'completed_at',completed_at,'created_at',created_at,'updated_at',updated_at,'source',source,'started_at',started_at,'participant_id',participant_id) AS row_json FROM responses UNION ALL SELECT 'revision_metric_counters' AS table_name, json_object('id',id,'revision_id',revision_id,'starts',starts,'completions',completions,'total_completion_milliseconds',total_completion_milliseconds,'mobile_starts',mobile_starts,'tablet_starts',tablet_starts,'desktop_starts',desktop_starts,'created_at',created_at,'updated_at',updated_at) AS row_json FROM revision_metric_counters UNION ALL SELECT 'revision_step_metric_counters' AS table_name, json_object('id',id,'revision_id',revision_id,'step_stable_id',step_stable_id,'reached',reached,'dropped',dropped,'created_at',created_at,'updated_at',updated_at) AS row_json FROM revision_step_metric_counters UNION ALL SELECT 'workspaces' AS table_name, json_object('id',id,'name',name,'time_zone',time_zone,'created_at',created_at,'updated_at',updated_at,'sending_window_start',sending_window_start,'sending_window_end',sending_window_end,'setup_operator_initialized_at',setup_operator_initialized_at,'embed_allowed_origins_json',embed_allowed_origins_json) AS row_json FROM workspaces ORDER BY table_name, row_json

SELECT r.id AS response_id, r.state, f.slug, v.number AS revision, s.stable_id AS question_id, c.stable_id AS choice_id, b.destination_step_stable_id AS destination, o.id AS outbox_id, p.id AS participant_id, d.status AS delivery_status FROM responses r JOIN flows f ON f.id=r.flow_id JOIN flow_revisions v ON v.id=r.revision_id JOIN response_answers a ON a.response_id=r.id JOIN flow_steps s ON s.revision_id=v.id AND s.stable_id=a.step_id JOIN choice_options c ON c.step_id=s.id AND c.stable_id=json_extract(a.value_json,'$') JOIN flow_branch_rules b ON b.revision_id=v.id AND b.source_step_stable_id=s.stable_id JOIN response_outbox o ON o.response_id=r.id LEFT JOIN invitation_participants p ON p.id=r.participant_id LEFT JOIN mail_deliveries d ON d.participant_id=p.id ORDER BY r.id

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO response_outbox (id,workspace_id,response_id,kind,idempotency_key,payload_json,status,available_at,created_at,updated_at) SELECT 'duplicate-' || id,workspace_id,response_id,kind,idempotency_key,payload_json,status,available_at,created_at,updated_at FROM response_outbox WHERE id LIKE 'upgrade-outbox-%' RETURNING id
